conceptZh: 晚是太陽下山後的傍晚和夜晚
object: a squeaky pull-back toy race car with googly eyes and a tiny mimicking toy moon
morph: the sun component 日 sinks and the 免 shape settles beside it as a copycat moon mimics the car, completing 晚
creativeAngle: 賽車衝向夕陽，一個小月亮玩偶慢一拍學它的每個動作，鬧出誤會；日字旁沉下去，右邊「免」落定，詞用「晚安」。
promptEn: An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale peach-cream backdrop, locked camera. The only text is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 晚, centered in saturated indigo-violet strokes about 70 percent of frame height, with the narrow 日 on the left and the 免 part on the right. Cast: a squeaky pull-back race car named Zip, bright lemon yellow with big googly eyes and a spring in its back, and a tiny pale crescent-moon toy that copies everything Zip does exactly one beat late. Moment one, 0 to 1.7s: Zip is pulled back by an unseen spring with a ratchet squeak and launched across the bottom of frame, overshooting a little paper finish flag. The first 晚 is spoken as he blasts off and the small orange sun disc on the left of the glyph settles down into the square 日. Moment two, 1.7 to 3.4s: the crescent moon rolls in behind him and repeats the squeak, the pull-back and the overshoot one beat late, bumping into Zip's bumper just as he reverses, so they both bounce backward with swirling eyes. The second 晚 is spoken as the sun sinks and the 免 shape rises beside it. Moment three, 3.4 to 5.0s: Zip yawns and drives in a slow slalom while the moon yawns in a slow slalom one beat behind; Zip turns left, the moon turns right, and they swap places with a comic double-take, then Zip sneezes and the moon sneezes a second later, blowing tiny star dots off the floor. Moment four, 5.0s onward: Zip tucks under a small blanket of felt, and the moon tucks in half a second later. From 5.0 to 8.0s the glyph is perfectly still and uncovered while Zip and the moon doze at the bottom, googly eyes drooping in sync and slowly nodding off, never touching the strokes. Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「晚、晚、晚安」, slowly with clear tones as ㄨㄢˇ、ㄨㄢˇ、ㄨㄢˇ ㄢ. First 晚 near 0.7s, second near 2.4s, and 晚安 around 5.3s as they tuck in. Stop after the word. Only soft squeaks and a quiet yawn, no background music. Soft studio lighting, vivid not neon, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 晚.

conceptZh: 布忍者踮著吱吱叫的高抬腿，想偷走打瞌睡消防車車頂的小夕陽燈籠好讓天黑，煙霧彈卻在最糟的時候噗一聲炸開，消防車驚醒、兩人面對面尖叫，失控的水管一噴把忍者的布塊和水管圈甩成「免」，燈籠落成「日」，拼出一個「晚」。
object: a tiny felt ninja with a bright red scarf, a chunky dozing toy fire engine with a warm orange sun-lantern on its roof, and the engine's runaway hose
morph: the stolen sun-lantern slides down and settles as the square 日 on the left; the hose blast flings the ninja's felt scarf strips, hood and a loop of hose into the air and they land as the strokes of 免 on the right, completing 晚
creativeAngle: 前一版是安靜的賽車與月亮同步打呵欠，沒有真正的實體笑點。這版用「偷偷摸摸被嚇醒」的模式：忍者自以為隱形卻全身紅圍巾、每步都吱吱叫，煙霧彈在錯的時間爆開（煙霧本身就是「天色變暗」的視覺雙關），面對面尖叫後水管失控一噴，撞擊本身把零件甩成筆畫。晚安由忍者被水管裹成毯子打呵欠揮手來演出，語音與畫面同一個故事。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D animated toy clip on a clean solid pale lavender-cream backdrop, locked camera, soft even studio light. The only text ever on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 晚, which finishes centered in saturated deep plum-indigo strokes about 70 percent of frame height: a narrow square 日 on the left and the 免 part on the right. Cast: a tiny felt ninja named Patch, stitched from charcoal felt with a huge bright red scarf, big round button eyes and a belt of little felt smoke bombs, who is certain he is invisible while standing in plain sight. Second character: a chunky cherry-red toy fire engine, dozing at frame right with its headlights shut and a tiny felt Z puffing from its cab, a warm orange paper sun-lantern glowing on its roof. Its canvas hose dangles like a sleeping snake.

Moment one, 0 to 1.5s: Patch peeks from behind a felt bush far left, scarf flapping obviously, and points hard at the sun-lantern. He wants the lantern so the day can finally end. He strikes a dramatic sneak pose.

Moment two, 1.5 to 3.2s: Patch tiptoes across the floor with exaggerated knee-high steps; every footstep squeaks like a rubber toy and each squeak makes the engine's roof light twitch. He stretches up, hooks the lantern with his scarf, and it slides down and settles on the left as the square 日. The first 晚 is spoken exactly as the lantern lands.

Moment three, 3.2 to 4.8s: Patch tiptoes away grinning, and a smoke bomb drops off his belt and goes POOF into a soft dusky-violet puff. The fire engine's headlights snap wide open. Patch and the engine come face to face, nose to bumper, both scream with wide open mouths, and the hose rears up alive and blasts Patch with a comic water jet. He squashes, stretches and spins; his red scarf strips, his hood and one loop of hose fly up and drop neatly into place as the strokes of 免 on the right. The second 晚 is spoken as those strokes snap still, completing 晚.

Moment four, 4.8 to 8.0s: the glyph stays perfectly still, centered and untouched. Below it at the bottom corners, the limp hose wraps around dripping Patch like a blanket. He gives one big yawn and a sleepy little wave; the fire engine dims its headlights to sleepy slits and waves a tiny ladder back. The word 晚安 is spoken right on the yawn and wave, around 5.5s. Patch nods off, head bobbing, never touching the strokes.

Audio: a warm friendly off-screen voice in clear Taiwanese Mandarin says exactly 「晚、晚、晚安」, read slowly and distinctly with clear tones as ㄨㄢˇ、ㄨㄢˇ、ㄨㄢˇ ㄢ, first 晚 near 2.9s, second near 4.6s, 晚安 near 5.5s, then stops. Only soft squeaks, a gentle poof, a cartoon splash and a quiet yawn, no background music. Bright but not neon, no flashing, no lens flare, no watermark, no subtitles, no vocabulary text, and no writing other than the single glyph 晚.
